shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; echo ----; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useThemeValue useTheme Switch SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton; echo ---; rg -n -C 4 -i 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useThemeValue useTheme ThemeContext SegmentedRadioGroup Switch 2>&1 | head -60; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm/components/theme 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts 2>&1

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n -C 4 -i 'useTheme|switch|toggle|ThemeProvider theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -80; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>&1 | head -80; ls ../../../ | head; grep -n "SegmentedRadioGroup\|Switch\|Text\b\|Flex" index.d.ts | head

cat Switch/Switch.d.ts; grep -n -A12 "interface ControlProps\b\|interface ControlGroupProps" types.d.ts; grep -rn "deprecated" Switch/ SegmentedRadioGroup/ theme/*.d.ts | head; ls layout/Flex Text | head

grep -n "layout\|Flex" index.d.ts; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|variant" text/*.d.ts Text/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "'subheader-2'\|\"subheader-2\"" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3; cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -n "gap\|alignItems\|direction" | head
